description: This file contains report generation logic for sales payment summaries in an ERP system, including functions to fetch and process sales invoice data, payment modes, and generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_pos_columns
methods.description: Returns column definitions for POS sales payment report.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Determines and returns report columns based on whether POS or regular sales.

methods.name: get_pos_sales_payment_data
methods.description: Fetches and formats POS sales invoice data for report.

methods.name: get_sales_payment_data
methods.description: Fetches and formats sales invoice data, including payment details, for report.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_pos_invoice_data
methods.description: Retrieves POS invoice data from database with applied filters.

methods.name: get_sales_invoice_data
methods.description: Retrieves sales invoice data from database with applied filters.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payments
methods.description: Retrieves payment modes associated with invoices.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Fetches list of invoice IDs based on filters.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payment_details
methods.description: Retrieves detailed payment mode information for invoices.
